Cost: 2,500eb (Very Expensive)
Type: Neuralware
Install: Hospital
Humanity Loss: 14 (4d6)
Option Slots: uses 0, provides 4

Borgware. Internal Body Cyberware. Wants a Neuroport, though it claims no Neuralware Option Slot, and 3 Internal Body Option Slots. In exchange it opens 4 further Neuralware Option Slots. Crushed Windpipe and Whiplash stop working on the user, effect and bonus damage alike. One per body. Anything keyed to a Cyberspine, drug or cyberware, treats this as one.

Foundry notes:

  • Typed as Neuralware so its 4 extra Neuralware slots are usable: the sheet only offers install targets whose cyberware type matches the option being installed. Its 3 Internal Body Option Slots are not tracked, and its size is 0 because Corgo says it takes no Neuralware slot.
  • Counts as Borgware for Maximum Humanity Loss; the sheet doesn't track that, so apply it by hand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Borgware).
